messages:
anya: Quick sync: we need a concise contract for hosted/dedicated/private flags. Proposal: signed policy snapshots + manifest precedence + local circuit breakers.

leo: Signed snapshot artifact is great for air-gapped installs. Keep format tiny (jsonl or proto) with snapshot_id, issued_at, ttl, policies[], signature.

tj: Precedence table suggestion: 1) manifest pin (local), 2) policy snapshot (signed), 3) client heuristics/circuit. Makes behavior deterministic.

sanju: Add manifest enum policy_influence: none|advisory|authoritative. Default advisory for private, authoritative for hosted.

mira: Telemetry: client shim emits fallback events with snapshot_id and manifest_version, no prompt text. Buffer locally for private installs.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: enable flag "quantized_fallback" -> hosted-r2: 15% (ts 4821250033)

anya: Emergency-off: support local toggle to ignore snapshots until reconcile. Control plane can publish a revocation list of snapshot_ids.

leo: Persist snapshots in shim (small sqlite). API: Shim.getPolicy(route) -> {policy, provenance}. Keep payload compact.

tj: Provide redwoodctl to sign snapshots for on-prem CI: redwoodctl snapshot sign --issuer infra --ttl 3600 --in p.json --out s.bin. Document verification steps.

sanju: Rollout playbook: require docs, telemetry points, canary %, emergency-off tested. For private, advisory snapshots recommended.

anya: Agreed. Owners: leo snapshot spec, tj precedence + API, sanju telemetry, mira manifest docs. I'll file RFC with these artifacts. resolved. :white_check_mark:
